zh.title: 英國下議院委員會要求重新評估希斯洛第三跑道
zh.summary: 運輸委員會認為，政府應先補強擴建案的經濟與環境論證。
body: 英國下議院運輸委員會11月26日公佈對希斯洛擴建政策草案的審查報告，認為政府目前提出的論證不足以支持第三跑道，建議先重新評估。
報告要求補強經濟效益及對碳排放、噪音與空氣品質的評估，並制定整體航空策略。擴建政策草案將作為日後審查開發許可的依據，工程仍須經法定程序審查。

en.title: UK Commons committee calls for Heathrow third-runway rethink
en.summary: The Transport Committee said the government should strengthen the economic and environmental case for expansion.
body: The House of Commons Transport Committee published its review of the draft Heathrow expansion policy on November 26. It concluded that ministers had yet to make a convincing case for a third runway and called for the plans to be reconsidered.

The report sought stronger evidence on economic benefits, carbon emissions, noise and air quality, as well as an overall aviation strategy. The draft policy would guide later planning decisions, and construction remains subject to statutory consent.

facts.claim: The Transport Committee said the government should strengthen the economic and environmental case for expansion.
